conf.comment: openshift / oauth-audit / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Kubernetes integration (audit_logs data stream)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
